bends.reason: STATE_CHECK case; recipe B1 (1 . B1 . 8cbf6b) is clearly folded. Raw scan (own principal frame, registration-free) FRONT view shows one rounded bend joining a long straight base leg to a short straight flange leg, both legs densely sampled on both sheet faces (649 of 2255 FRONT-panel points on the flange side); raw ISO shows the flange rising edge-on from the end of the flat holed base. Pixel line fits of the FRONT profiles: raw scan ~57.5 deg from flat vs recipe CAD ~56.9 deg (projected, approximate), so the fold matches the CAD angle, not a partial or flat state. Leg proportions and hole layout match the CAD mirrored (raw frame is mirrored): the flange carries the end hole and the nearest base hole sits just inboard of the bend, so the observed bend is at the B1 location. Overlay (registration confidence OK, display aid only) agrees: scan points lie on both the CAD base and the CAD flange at B1. No extra bend seen. Direction: a lone bend on a centerline-symmetric blank is congruent either way, so up/down direction is not observable from geometry; no reverse-direction evidence. Images: raw_views, cad_numbered_views, overlay_views (plus zoomed crops of the same three); no section images exist for this case.
